correctness.rationale: DLMF 18.27.21 expansion, Euler product and an exponentially controlled coefficient-ratio approximation establish a uniform C^2 exterior expression \(h_n=x^nF_q+O(\rho_q^n)\). The remaining interior has exponential decay; F_q has a simple endpoint zero with slope 2C_q. Squaring/summing produces \(E_N=x^{2N+2}G_q+O(\rho_q^N)\), \(G_q\sim2C_q^4(1-x)\). Optimize s=N(1-x), obtain \(C_q^4/e\) and location \(1/(2N)+O(N^{-2})\); Cauchy–Schwarz makes the diagonal maximum the full bivariate sup; strict concavity at global maximizing layer establishes uniqueness. Exact identity checks and numerical boundary layer tests gave CHECK_OK 198. No finite evidence is treated as the proof.

value.rationale: Determines the optimal uniform truncation error of a motivated newly defined orthogonal-polynomial machine-learning kernel, explains a polynomial-rate boundary-layer obstruction despite geometric recurrence coefficients, and locates every eventual worst-case diagonal point. These precise facts are needed to understand uniform degree choice and are not finite-degree boundedness exercises. The same calculation also supplies the exact sharp polynomial sup-norm asymptotic.
